description:
Add a Strassen-family layer above the existing GF(2) M4RM matrix multiplication path, with benchmark-driven production dispatch when a winning crossover exists.

## Background

`64c88ae4` and `dev/bench_results/2026-04-26-uncompetitiveness-profile.md` show GF(2) matrix multiplication at n=1024..4096 is only about 0.13-0.21x of M4RI. M4RI switches to Strassen-Winograd at large sizes; gf2-core previously used pure schoolbook/M4RM. SIMD routing helps but cannot close the algorithmic exponent gap by itself.

## Amendment Note

User-approved scope amendment after the focused implementation and scratch/view rework measured no winning Strassen crossover through n=8192: accept the correctness/test-support Strassen-family scaffold and keep production `BitMatrix` multiplication on M4RM-only dispatch until a future task demonstrates an empirical crossover. Evidence is recorded in `dev/bench_results/2026-04-29-strassen-matmul-crossover.md`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] A Strassen-family multiplication path exists for square GF(2) `BitMatrix` multiplication as a correctness/test-support and benchmark-forcing scaffold, while production `BitMatrix` multiplication remains on the existing M4RM/scalar fallback path until a future empirical crossover demonstrates a win.
- [hard] Correctness is covered by deterministic edge tests and property tests against the existing `BitMatrix::mul` semantics, including n in {0, 1, 63, 64, 65, 127, 128, 129, 256, 512} and at least one larger release-only benchmark validation size.
- [hard] The implementation preserves tail masking and introduces no `unsafe` outside `gf2-kernels-simd`.
- [hard] Benchmark evidence records that no production crossover was selected after measurements through n=8192, compares the forced scaffold against the M4RM production path, and relates the result to the pinned gf2 baseline and the `64c88ae4` M4RI ratios where available.
- [hard] `cargo-ci` and `code-review` gates pass.
- [aspirational] GF(2) matmul at n>=1024 closes at least half of the residual gap to M4RI after the Tier-A/B kernel work lands; current evidence shows this remains future work because no winning Strassen crossover was found.
title: Add Strassen-Winograd layer for GF(2) BitMatrix multiply
